notes:
Landed the manifold-diagnostics aggregate exactly as designed, with two mechanical transcription fixes required to compile (both recorded as deviations; neither changes any public type, shape, method signature, or algorithm semantically), plus one forced reading of a pre-decided clause that the normative tests pin. (1) EdgeDiagnostic and OrientationConflict as quoted declare a type parameter P that is never used in their fields, which is a hard rustc error E0392 ('parameter P is never used', empirically confirmed). Added a private `_marker: PhantomData

` field to each (rustc's own suggested remedy); the public field set and every signature stay exactly as quoted, and the marker field is invisible to callers (tests never construct these types - they only read them via diagnose). (2) The packet's quoted `use crate::shell::{Shell, ShellCondition};` cannot compile: Shell is defined at the crate root (lib.rs:168) and crate::shell::Shell is only a private re-export (shell.rs starts with `use crate::*;`), so importing it through crate::shell is E0365 'private import'. Split into `use crate::shell::ShellCondition;` plus `use crate::Shell;` - pure import plumbing. Reading note on the vertex-link classification clause 'any link-vertex with degree != 2 -> NonManifold': applied literally it makes BoundaryPath unreachable, which the required tests contradict (open_box_has_boundary_path_links and two_sheets_pinch_is_nonmanifold_at_vertex require BoundaryPath for path-shaped links whose endpoints have degree 1). classify_link therefore treats degree 1 as a path endpoint, degree >= 3 as branching (NonManifold), all-degree-2 single component as ClosedCycle, exactly-two-degree-1 single component as BoundaryPath, and everything else (disconnected or mixed) as NonManifold - the only reading consistent with the normative tests. Everything else is a verbatim transcription: the six types, diagnose (edge census over absolute_boundaries with direction corrected by face orientation; per-edge ordinal-sorted boundary/irregular/conflict vectors), orientation_parity (BFS over face_adjacency seeded at the lowest-ordinal face with true, crossing only opposite-effective-direction edges, deterministic face/edge-ordinal neighbor order; conflicts non-empty implies parity None, the direction the tests pin), and the lib.rs module declaration (the packet's exact block inserted after the invariants module; nothing else in lib.rs moved). H-1/H-3/GATE-1/GATE-3/GATE-4 clean: no unwrap/expect/panic/todo/unimplemented, no out-of-range indexing, no 1e- literals, no debug_new/cfg!(debug_assertions), no unscaled_legacy, no #[allow]. No existing test deleted, ignored, or weakened. All 7 manifold_diag tests pass alongside the full pre-existing suite (75 lib + 2 euler_operators + 1 extracases + 1 parallel_query; the pre-existing ignored large-solid-torus main is untouched). Done-when gates all green on the committed tree: cargo fmt --check -p truck-topology; cargo clippy -p truck-topology --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test -p truck-topology --lib --tests. Committed on packet/BG-CG-006-DIAG as 4f0b30e with the mandated subject before writing this RESULT.json.
